data.gender_notes: Asahel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Asahel is derived from the Hebrew words 'asah' meaning 'help' and 'el' meaning 'God'. It is the name of a brave and resourceful warrior in the Bible who was a relative of David. Asahel is a meaningful name for a Christian boy, symbolizing God's help and assistance throughout his life. The name Asahel carries the meaning “God is my help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Asahel usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my help and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Asahel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is my help.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asahel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: עשהאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עשה-מאושר (he who is blessed) - עשה (to do) + מאושר (blessed, prosperous). העושה-אל-אלה (the one who does God's work) - העושה (the one who does) + אל-אלה (God, divine power).

in_greek.name: Ἀσαήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: οἰκῶντος-ἀληθής (he who is true and faithful) - οἰκῶντος (inhabiting, dwelling) + ἀληθής (true, faithful). ὁ-οἰκῶν-ἀλήθεια (the one who dwells in truth) - ὁ (the one) + οἰκῶν (dwelling) + ἀλήθεια (truth, divine revelation).

in_latin.name: Asahel
in_latin.long_meaning: faciens-beatus (he who does blessed works) - faciens (doing) + beatus (blessed). qui-facit-veritas (he who does truth) - qui (he who) + facit (does) + veritas (truth, divine revelation).

in_english.name: Asahel
in_english.meaning: he who does blessed works, blessed in actions, or the one who does truth
in_english.long_meaning: Asahel is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, meaning 'he who is blessed' or 'the one who does God's work.' It is associated with the biblical figure of Asahel, a warrior and a follower of David. In Christian tradition, the name represents faithfulness, loyalty, and a strong relationship with God. Individuals with the name Asahel are often seen as blessed, prosperous, and true to their values.
